schema: stages/1 (Build from Plan Deck commands and stages, moved out of pipeline.json)

entry.render: bash public/build-from-deck-pipeline/tools/render_room.sh <CODE> --res 960 --samples 24 (repo root; needs the Floorplan Renderer skill scripts in pipeline-work/build-from-deck/renderer)

stages.out: trace.px.json (agent reads plan pixels) -> plan.json (tracer-plan/1) + <CODE>.canvas.json via the Tracer exporter, zones snapped to walls, geometry_check.png
resolve.json (deck-resolve/1): item -> object + real param ids + host + materials; new objects (objects/) and materials (materials/) published to R2
<CODE>.room.canvas.json (R2 Designs/Decks/<CODE>.json): every attachment = object params + spec_* + provenance; baked headless with tools/bakeplan
<CODE>_drawings.dxf (R2010, 4 A1 layouts: A-101 plan 1:25, A-102 RCP 1:25, A-201 interior elevations 1:50, A-601 schedules) + PDF + PNGs; R2 Designs/Decks/<CODE>/
<CODE>.blend (Cycles, deck materials, lamps from fixture photometry, deck cameras CAM-A/B/C + corners) + low-quality stills
QA.md + qa_compare.png: deck review comments tested on baked geometry/params, coverage, deck render vs still (palette dE + mid-tone colour cast)
